page.layout: One page of verse, one column of text, centred; running head at top; page number top left; no margin notes; catchword "Obiiciat" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.l: Pérque vias digito stulta iuuenta notet.
Vos, age, quid statis? scelerato auferte lacernam,
Vt vitium lingua cetera membra luant.
Nec mora, diripiunt fratres à pectore vestes,
Seétáque nodosa cannabe terga notant,
Alternántque vices, & acerbant verbera verbis,
Verba oculis, oculos nutibus atque minis.
Dum feriunt, numerant ad singula verbera Dinos,
Grata foret cunctis ceu mea pœna Deis.
Nec mea carnifices fratres lassant mala, quamuis
Deficerent Diui, deficerëtque dies.
Perdiderat rabiésque modum, plagaque figurán,
Atque vnum in toto corpore vulnus erat.
Talis erat (si vera fides) Hieronymus olim,
Dum studium ob Tulli vapulat ante Deum:
Sic cute direpta Satyrum videre Celene
Tibia cum blanda est vińta canore lyra.
Vt primum sari licuit, méque ipse recepi
Nudus, & in nuda sanguinolentus humo,
Clamabam, Nunc parce pater, nunc parcite fratres,
Cæde mea sanctas confcelerare manus.
Parce pater, sic ille sacer Seraphicus ordo
Floreat auspiciis sanctior vsque tuis:
Sic mendicantum genti turba infcia veri
Affluat, & nunquam credula desit anus:
Vestra nec incauto pateant mendacia vulgo,
Nec videat crassos plebs tunicata dolos:
Et noua sub patribus tironum turba seueris,
Inueniat quastus ingeniosa nouos:
Seu male lustratis manes exire sepulcris,
Fingere, seu tacita somnia nocte libet,
Relligio nubes animis offundat agrestum,
Obiiciat

page.notes: Page is verse; the long s is rendered as plain s. Some words in the first lines are faint and marked by the scan's wear; "Seétáque", "Dinos", "Perdiderat" and "vińta" are doubtful. The catchword "Obiiciat" is repeated at the foot of the last line and is given once as catchword and once as final line; the catchword is the printed word at the foot.
